Messages.Author: Justin Fang
Messages.Body:
If I gain temporary control of a vampire (e.g. Mind Rape) and I have that
vampire use a card which is put on the acting vampire, do I still control
that card when control of that vampire reverts?

--
Justin Fang (jus...@ugcs.caltech.edu)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Justin Fang wrote:
>
> If I gain temporary control of a vampire (e.g. Mind Rape) and I have that
> vampire use a card which is put on the acting vampire, do I still control
> that card when control of that vampire reverts?

No. Minion cards are controlled by the controller of the minion
that they are on, unless card text says otherwise (like a successful
Shepherd's Innocence).
